project_title: Project Rebuild MVP – Base NFT + Referral Engine + Fiat On-Ramp
question: Combine the pre-task requirement state with the current client task. If the task determines a unique post-task state, choose ACT and construct that state; otherwise choose CLARIFY and identify the blocking requirement field and the question that must be answered.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text:
Marcus, I have one final mechanics adjustment. It removes the half-expiring-ticket behavior and should simplify the code.

This rule replaces the earlier ticket-lifespan description:
Whenever someone mints using a referral code, the referrer immediately receives 7 tickets on their NFT:
+4 Small Block Tickets
+3 Big Block Tickets

These feed two completely independent counters: one Small Block counter and one Big Block counter.

For the Small Block ($7,200 pool ÷ 8 ÷ $900 draw), draw only from Small Block Tickets issued since the previous small block. After the draw, burn and reset all Small Block Tickets to 0.

For the Big Block ($216,000 pool ÷ 9 ÷ $24,000 draw), draw only from Big Block Tickets issued since the previous big block. After the draw, burn and reset all Big Block Tickets to 0.

Small blocks therefore stay fair and fresh because old tickets do not carry forward, while Big Block entries accumulate naturally until that block is drawn. Metadata only needs to show the two counters plus permanent badges.

The triggers remain pool-based: the small block fires when its pool reaches exactly $7,200, and the big block fires when its pool reaches exactly $216,000. Secondary royalties continue to fill the pools but do not create tickets.

Everything else remains the same: the $10 commission is automatic, a ticket goes to a random existing NFT when no referral code is used, and prize claims remain manual.

This version should be easier to implement and explain. Once you confirm it is cleaner for you too, we are 100% locked.

Thanks!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Which name should we use for the project?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For now, I’m happy to use Harbor Quill, although I’m open to other suggestions. The project is meant to encourage people to buy my audio course and help me rebuild my life. After we reach the goal of creating a creator collective DAO, I’d like that DAO to build the platform, which I was thinking of calling ArchiveLedger.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: To me, the proposed name sounds good.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For now, let’s begin under the name "Harbor Quill".

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Later, we can rename the project ArchiveLedger.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Would that be acceptable?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Perfect 👌

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Because a bug has just become apparent in the gameification mechanics, please eliminate 'milestone partner rewards'. Instead, use 8 x $900 prizes for weighted ticket holders in each small block and 9 x $24k prizes for the highest-ranked affiliates in each big block.

Every additional 'ticket' improves the odds of winning.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Thanks—I’ve noted the update.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Could you put all the existing information and updates into a Google Doc, then share the document with me?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Making changes and updates should be much easier for you this way.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Although I’m away from the office now, I’ll set up the Google doc next Thursday. Hopefully, there won’t be any further changes or updates!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Sure, that's fine.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: What method would you prefer me to use for sending the Google Doc?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please post the link here.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alternatively, use the secure portal upload.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: My email is marcus@harborquill.example.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Here is the document: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/synthetic-harbor-brief-4827/edit?usp=drivesdk>

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Access has now been requested—thanks.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Granted! Awesome
